entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7), 29 Nov. 1402
entries.german: Hans von Rosenberg quittirt den Burggrafen von Nürnberg um 60 Gulden rhein. G. am Mittwoche nehst vor St. Niclas Tag. (c. 1 Sig.)
entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg acknowledges receipt from the Burgraves of Nuremberg of 60 Rhenish gulden. Given on the Wednesday nearest before St. Nicholas's day. (With 1 seal.)

facts.content: issued a quittance to the Burgraves of Nuremberg for 60 Rhenish gulden.

source: Mario Müller, Regesten zur Biografie und Herrschaft des Nürnberger Burggrafen und Brandenburger Kurfürsten Friedrich VI. (I.), Nr. 276, p. 342
entries.german: Hans von Rosenberg beurkundet, dass Friedr. v. Nürnberg alle Schulden ihm gegenüber abgetragen hat.
entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg certifies that Friedrich von Nuremberg had repaid all debts owed to him.

facts.content: certified that Friedrich von Nürnberg had repaid all debts owed to him.
